name: discord-call-bridge
description: Guided Windows setup and verified two-way Discord Voice routing.

interface.shortDescription: Set up and test a Windows Discord Voice bridge.
interface.longDescription: Portable call instructions and a Windows setup wizard for isolated send and return audio, with per-machine preferences and explicit acceptance checks.
interface.defaultPrompt: Act as my setup wizard and technical expert: set up, troubleshoot and verify Discord Call Bridge using the supported methods you judge appropriate. Treat bundled recipes as advice and handle the work yourself.
